text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — found a mismatch between TS SDK and REST on /v1/generate params.
Alex: TS SDK uses `maxTokens` (default 512) and `responseFormat: 'json'`.
Alex: REST endpoint expects `max_tokens` (default 1024) and accepts `response_format: 'jsonl' | 'json'`.
Maria: hmm — TS SDK should map both keys in serialization. Which client version?
Alex: @Maria v1.6.2
Alex: I tested curl: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"max_tokens":1024}'` returns 1024 tokens. TS SDK request shows 512 in server logs.
Jamal: backend here — REST uses max_tokens, server default 1024. If client omits max_tokens we fallback to 1024. If client sends maxTokens we should parse? Currently we only look for snake_case in the request body.
Maria: bug then — TS SDK serializer is sending camelCase in body and backend ignores it. That's bad.
Priya: for compatibility we should accept both `max_tokens` and `maxTokens` server-side, and add a warning header if camelCase used.
Alex: Also noticed `top_p` vs `topP` — same issue.
Jamal: Agree. I'll open a backend PR to accept both forms and add telemetry. ETA today.
Maria: I'll patch TS SDK to send snake_case by default and add a flag `useCamelCaseCompatibility` for legacy consumers.
Priya: Can we also add unit/integration tests: curl vs SDK parity tests in CI? Add a small smoke test that compares JSON bodies.
ci-bot: tests/generate_parity_tests failed on master — 1 mismatch: topP vs top_p. https://ci.example.com/1234
Maria: On it. Pushing a test fix.
Alex: One more: Python SDK currently exposes parameter `max_tokens` (snake_case) but its default is 512 too — so that means two SDKs disagree on defaults.
Maria: Oof. We need a docs source of truth. @Priya can we align defaults to server default (1024) across SDKs and add deprecation notes?
Priya: Yes. I'll update the SDK policy doc + release checklist. We'll bump patch versions and call out the change.
Jamal: Backend will accept both variants for 3 months, log usage, then enforce snake_case.
Alex: Sounds good. I'll add a short changelog entry and ping support to expect some user tickets.
Maria: I'll do a quick release with tests tonight. TY!
Priya: Assigning followups: @Jamal backend PR, @Maria TS SDK patch, @Priya docs + release note, @Alex support heads-up.
Alex: thanks :thumbsup:
